feeds.title: Wild In Nature
feeds.description: Wild In Nature blog follows Susan, an adventurous soul whose passion for the great outdoors is beautifully captured in her hiking blog. As a dedicated hiker, Susan shares her awe-inspiring journeys through the rugged terrains, picturesque trails, and breathtaking landscapes she explores.

feeds.title: Brooke In Boots
feeds.description: Featuring itineraries, travel tips and tricks, wanderlust inspiration and photography from around the world. Brooke in Boots is a hiking and outdoor travel blog

feeds.title: Andy's walks in the world
feeds.description: A blog about travel, hiking, adventures, and misadventures. Andrea is a blogger from Georgia who loves to travel, especially active travel- hiking, biking, kayaking, etc., and experiencing other cultures. Read about her newest hiking adventures and travel stories across the globe here.

feeds.title: Hike Like A Woman Blog
feeds.description: The blog for and by outdoor women sharing inspiring tales, tips and true stories from the trail.

feeds.title: All Women All Trails
feeds.description: All Women All Trails is the new permanent home of the shared wisdom, experiences, and support that have appeared in the Facebook group since the beginning. We have an amazing bunch of writers and bloggers sharing their thoughts here.

feeds.title: Hiking Lady Blog
feeds.description: Hiking Lady is an online publication for women who love the outdoors, and choose to explore it by hiking, backpacking, and camping. Additionally, the blog is an up-to-date resource with articles of interest, events, environmental issues, book and movie reviews, organizations to join, and deals on hiking gear and apparel.

feeds.title: Fat Girls Hiking Blog
feeds.description: A Body Positive Community for Outdoor Enthusiast that showcases the hiking adventures of these women all around US.

feeds.title: Mountains with Megan Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Megan. I'm a long-distance hiker, blogger, author, and outdoor professional. I travel all over the world in search of mountains and trails. I found my love of hiking on the Appalachian Trail back in 2012 and since then have hiked in the Himalayas, the Andes, and Eastern Europe.

feeds.title: Hike Up Your Skirt Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Suzie, a freelance writer and blogger in north Lake Tahoe, California. HikeUpYourSkirt is a blog focused on adventurous travel and making the great outdoors accessible and welcoming for everyone.

feeds.title: Adventures in Good Company Blog
feeds.description: The Adventuress is a blog for women with adventurous spirits. It's a source of inspiration, planning, tips, and advice from experienced travelers and outdoor adventurers with the extra flair of being for women and by women only.

feeds.title: The Modern Female Hiker
feeds.description: The hikes I post about range from beginning hikes to advanced technical hikes that in some instances require backcountry experience. I enjoy relaxing 3 hour strolls as much as heart pumping 5000 ft elevation gain adventures, and my goal is to share these authentic experiences with you.
